author_note: Test split for the report ledger checker (F2). 12 defective ledgers (8 to 25 transactions, one to three injected defects, every code covered at least once more) plus 3 clean ledgers (rc-t13, rc-t14, rc-t15) with expected_findings [] that carry near-miss traps: incomes without receipts, a budget at 79.9 percent of its threshold, a 4,999.99 unlinked expense, a pending budget with no spend, same-amount rows that differ in date or category. Side effects are included in expected_findings (rc-t11 is one double-entered 5,200 expense that yields five findings).
